description: The hemoglobin protein structure (PDB: 4HHB) is loaded in PyMOL. Hemoglobin is a tetramer composed of four polypeptide chains: two alpha subunits (chains A and C) and two beta subunits (chains B and D). Your task is to visualize the quaternary structure by switching to cartoon representation and coloring each chain a distinct color so the four subunits are easy to distinguish. Use red for chain A, green for chain B, blue for chain C, and yellow for chain D. The final view should clearly show all four chains of the hemoglobin tetramer in cartoon mode with the specified color scheme.
